description: This file defines classes and functions for interacting with different Large Language Model (LLM) providers, specifically Gemini and Anthropic. It includes configuration, client initialization, and content generation methods.

classes.name: LLMProvider
classes.description: An enumeration for selecting between different LLM providers, specifically Anthropic and Gemini.

classes.name: LLMClient
classes.description: A client class for interacting with the specified LLM provider, capable of generating content based on prompts.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the LLMClient with the specified provider, configuring the client accordingly.

methods.name: generate_content
methods.description: Generates content from the LLM based on the provided prompt.
